faq.q: Is MacKenzie Heights its own City of Vancouver neighbourhood?
faq.a: Not one of the 22 distinct local areas — the City lists "MacKenzie Heights" as a recognised smaller area inside the Kerrisdale local area, on the slope between Shaughnessy and Kerrisdale Village.

faq.q: Which schools are near MacKenzie Heights?
faq.a: Maple Grove Elementary (1924 West 45th Avenue) and McKechnie Elementary (7455 Maple Street) are the VSB elementaries listed for Kerrisdale, and Magee Secondary (6360 Maple Street) is physically in Kerrisdale — but secondary catchments split between Magee and Point Grey by address, so check the exact address in the VSB locator.

faq.q: Is MacKenzie Heights the same as Mackenzie Elementary's area?
faq.a: No — Sir Alexander Mackenzie Elementary (960 East 39th Avenue) is in Kensington-Cedar Cottage, Vancouver East; MacKenzie Heights is a west-side pocket inside Kerrisdale.

faq.q: Can a MacKenzie Heights house lot be redeveloped as a multiplex?
faq.a: Generally yes where the R1-1 schedule is met — up to 6 strata units or 8 secured rental units per lot, with minimum site areas from 306 m² to 557 m² by form, plus suite and laneway options on a house.

faq.q: What is the shopping area for MacKenzie Heights?
faq.a: Kerrisdale Village on West 41st Avenue — the City calls it the main shopping area of the surrounding local area, with more than 250 businesses and services promoted by the Kerrisdale Business Association between Maple and Larch Streets and along the Boulevards.
